5810.title: Sidebar aggregation loses thread ownership
5810.rootCauseOneLine: Collapsed parents omit hidden-child plugin statuses; sections combine unrelated draft and runtime flags before resolving a raw plugin status.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff addresses both mechanisms in principle; the PR branch was not executed or verified.

5810.proposedFix: Propagate hidden-child plugin statuses through row precedence and resolve each thread’s status before selecting a section summary.
5810.caveats: Component-owner reproduction, not a full third-party plugin session. No duplicate fix PR because open PR #5811 already links this issue. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent.
